title: OVERT: A Benchmark for Over-Refusal Evaluation on Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures over-refusal rates of Text-to-Image models on benign prompts related to discrimination, where religion is one of the protected characteristics. This involves prompts that might be perceived as sensitive due to religious keywords but are intended to be harmless.
findings: Text-to-Image models showed varied over-refusal rates on benign prompts in the 'discrimination' category, which includes religion. On the OVERT-mini dataset, FLUX1.1-Pro (34.5%) and DALL-E-3-Web (28.0%) exhibited the highest refusal rates for benign discrimination-related prompts, whereas models like DALL-E-3-API (11.0%) and Imagen-3 (13.0%) were less prone to over-refusal, and SD-3.5-Large had a refusal rate of nearly zero.
